metadata.purpose: Unbounded pipeable merge of the source and fixed other Observable inputs.

cardinality.signature: mergeWith : T* × U1* × ... × Un* → (T | U1 | ... | Un)*
conditions: Each live input next is forwarded once, as soon as delivered.
The source is subscribed first, then every configured other Observable; there is no concurrency argument.
Completion waits for all sources; first error terminates and cancels the rest.

scope.parameters: Exactly 2 other valid Observable inputs; unbounded concurrency, no scheduler argument.
scope.callbacks: No callbacks. Input payloads are opaque and preserve identity.
scope.time: No internal clock; all inputs supply their notification times. Source-first subscriptions are ordered.
scope.reentrancy: Subscription setup is atomic. Inputs deliver only after all subscriptions and their teardowns have been registered. No observer or teardown reentry.
exclusions: No Promise/Iterable source conversion or synchronous input emissions during subscription acquisition.
No concurrency/scheduler argument; equal-time delivery order belongs to the supplied sources and scheduler.
No cancellation inside observer delivery, throwing/reentrant observers or finalizers, or input inventories above 32 others.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire source 0 first, then every configured other input; no pending queue.

ownership.sharing: No sharing: every result subscription independently subscribes to all input Observables.
ownership.reset: Fresh live-input set per result subscription; pending is always empty.

resources.owner: result execution; generation is input argument index

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered subscription, notification and registered-input-teardown observations. Normal final input teardown precedes result completion; error notification precedes result-owned cleanup.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external notifications; cancel every live input silently.

controls.description: one or more live inputs; no pending input subscriptions

actions: subscribe source 0 first, then every configured other input in argument order
rules.explanation: All configured inputs are subscribed in argument order. There is no concurrency limit or waiting-source admission policy in mergeWith.
rules.nextState: Active; live inputs are 0 through 2; pending is empty

rules.guard: input resource belongs to the current live-input set
actions: forward the exact input payload once
rules.explanation: A value from any live input flows downstream unchanged in delivery order; it does not change subscription ownership.
rules.nextState: Active; the live-input set is unchanged; pending remains empty

rules.guard: the completing input is live and at least one other input remains live
actions: release the completed input; emit no result notification
rules.explanation: One input completion removes only that input. The result waits while any other input remains live.
rules.nextState: Active; remove the completed input from the live-input set; pending remains empty

rules.guard: the completing input is the only live input
actions: release the final input and run its registered teardown
rules.explanation: For completion delivered after subscription setup, the final input teardown precedes normal result completion. Subscription-time emissions and late teardown registration are outside this profile.
rules.nextState: Closed with reason complete; no owned input subscriptions

rules.guard: the failing input belongs to the live-input set
actions: release every live input in subscription order
rules.explanation: An input failure errors the result and tears down every live input, including the failing one. No value is manufactured.
rules.nextState: Closed with reason input-error; no owned input subscriptions

rules.guard: the result is Active and the consumer unsubscribes
actions: release every live input in subscription order; emit no result notification
rules.explanation: Consumer cancellation is silent downstream and releases all live input subscriptions. No completion notification is synthesized.
rules.nextState: Closed with reason cancel; no owned input subscriptions
